name: CI

on: [push, pull_request]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    # MongoDB 8.0 refuses to start on the runner's Linux kernel (6.19+),
    # see https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-121912.
    services:
      mongodb:
        image: mongo:7.0
        ports:
          - 27017:27017

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.20'

      # Started with plain docker instead of a third-party action: the ASF org
      # only allows actions owned by GitHub or by the enterprise allow-list.
      # A service container cannot be used here because the replica set needs a
      # custom mongod command plus rs.initiate().
      - name: Start MongoDB replica set
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          docker run -d --name mongo-rs -p 42069:42069 mongo:7.0 \
            mongod --replSet test-rs --port 42069 --bind_ip_all

          echo "Waiting for mongod to accept connections..."
          for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
            if docker exec mongo-rs mongosh --port 42069 --quiet \
                --eval 'db.adminCommand({ ping: 1 })' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

          docker exec mongo-rs mongosh --port 42069 --quiet --eval \
            'rs.initiate({ _id: "test-rs", members: [{ _id: 0, host: "127.0.0.1:42069" }] })'

          echo "Waiting for the replica set to elect a primary..."
          for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
            if docker exec mongo-rs mongosh --port 42069 --quiet \
                --eval 'quit(db.hello().isWritablePrimary ? 0 : 1)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

          echo "Replica set did not become primary in time" >&2
          docker logs mongo-rs
          exit 1

      - name: Run Unit tests
        run: go test -v -coverprofile=./profile.cov ./...

      - name: Coverage summary
        if: always()
        run: go tool cover -func=./profile.cov

      - name: Upload coverage profile
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-profile
          path: ./profile.cov
          if-no-files-found: ignore

[request_definition]
r = sub, obj, act

[policy_definition]
p = sub, obj, act

[role_definition]
g = _, _

[policy_effect]
e = some(where (p.eft == allow))

[matchers]
m = g(r.sub, p.sub) && r.obj == p.obj && r.act == p.act

name: Release

# Releases are cut manually by pushing a git tag:
#   v1.4.0-rc1 -> GitHub pre-release only (source package for the Apache vote)
#   v1.4.0     -> GitHub release (the Go module is published automatically by
#                 proxy.golang.org once the tag exists)
#
# The release manager downloads the source package from the release, signs it
# locally with their own GPG key, and uses it for the vote. This workflow does
# not sign anything and does not touch any other Apache infrastructure.

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'apache/casbin-mongodb-adapter' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Compute release metadata
        id: meta
        run: |
          TAG_NAME="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"

          if [[ "${TAG_NAME}" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            PRERELEASE=false
          elif [[ "${TAG_NAME}" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-rc[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            PRERELEASE=true
          else
            echo "Unsupported release tag: ${TAG_NAME}. Use v1.2.3 or v1.2.3-rc1." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          VERSION="${TAG_NAME#v}"
          BASENAME="casbin-mongodb-adapter-${VERSION}-incubating-src"

          {
            echo "tag=${TAG_NAME}"
            echo "version=${VERSION}"
            echo "basename=${BASENAME}"
            echo "prerelease=${PRERELEASE}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Build source release tarball
        env:
          BASENAME: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.basename }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p dist
          git archive --format=tar.gz --prefix="${BASENAME}/" -o "dist/${BASENAME}.tar.gz" "${TAG}"
          cd dist
          sha512sum "${BASENAME}.tar.gz" > "${BASENAME}.tar.gz.sha512"
          sha512sum -c "${BASENAME}.tar.gz.sha512"
          ls -l

      - name: Write release notes
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
          PRERELEASE: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.prerelease }}
          BASENAME: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.basename }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          {
            if [[ "${PRERELEASE}" == "true" ]]; then
              printf 'Release candidate for version `%s`. This is **not** a released version; it is the source artifact for the Apache release vote.\n' "${VERSION%%-rc*}"
            else
              printf 'Version `%s`.\n' "${VERSION}"
            fi
            printf '\n| Asset | Description |\n| --- | --- |\n'
            printf '| `%s.tar.gz` | Source release |\n' "${BASENAME}"
            printf '| `%s.tar.gz.sha512` | SHA-512 checksum |\n\n' "${BASENAME}"
            printf 'The release manager signs the tarball locally with their own GPG key before starting the vote.\n'
          } > release-notes.md
          cat release-notes.md

      # The gh CLI is used instead of a marketplace action: the ASF org only
      # allows actions owned by GitHub or by the enterprise allow-list.
      - name: Create GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}
          BASENAME: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.basename }}
          PRERELEASE: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.prerelease }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(
            "${TAG}"
            --title "Casbin MongoDB Adapter ${TAG}"
            --notes-file release-notes.md
          )
          if [[ "${PRERELEASE}" == "true" ]]; then
            args+=(--prerelease)
          fi
          gh release create "${args[@]}" \
            "dist/${BASENAME}.tar.gz" \
            "dist/${BASENAME}.tar.gz.sha512"

module github.com/apache/casbin-mongodb-adapter/v4

go 1.20

require (
	github.com/casbin/casbin/v3 v3.10.0
	go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2 v2.2.1
)

require (
	github.com/bmatcuk/doublestar/v4 v4.6.1 // indirect
	github.com/casbin/govaluate v1.3.0 // indirect
	github.com/golang/snappy v1.0.0 // indirect
	github.com/google/uuid v1.6.0 // indirect
	github.com/klauspost/compress v1.16.7 // indirect
	github.com/xdg-go/pbkdf2 v1.0.0 // indirect
	github.com/xdg-go/scram v1.1.2 // indirect
	github.com/xdg-go/stringprep v1.0.4 // indirect
	github.com/youmark/pkcs8 v0.0.0-20240726163527-a2c0da244d78 // indirect
	golang.org/x/crypto v0.33.0 // indirect
	golang.org/x/sync v0.11.0 // indirect
	golang.org/x/text v0.22.0 // indirect
)

p, alice, data1, read
p, bob, data2, write
p, data2_admin, data2, read
p, data2_admin, data2, write
g, alice, data2_admin

[request_definition]
r = tenant, sub, obj, act, service

[policy_definition]
p =tenant, sub, obj, act, service, eft

[role_definition]
g = _, _

[policy_effect]
e = priority(p.eft) || deny

[matchers]
m = r.tenant == p.tenant && g(r.sub, p.sub) && keyMatch(r.obj, p.obj) && (r.act == p.act || p.act == "*") && (r.service == p.service || p.service == "*")

language: go

sudo: false

go:
  - tip

before_install:
  - go get github.com/mattn/goveralls

script:
  - $HOME/gopath/bin/goveralls -service=travis-ci

services:
  - mongodb
